description: Source code implementing DNS name validation and conversion utilities, including functions for validating DNS names, converting dotted names to network format, and canonicalizing names.

methods.name: IsValidDnsName
methods.description: Checks if a DNS name in dotted form is valid.

methods.name: IsValidDnsRecordName
methods.description: Checks if a DNS record name is valid, not localhost or IP literal.

methods.name: DottedNameToNetwork
methods.description: Converts a dotted DNS name to network byte format, with optional validation.

methods.name: NetworkToDottedName
methods.description: Converts network byte format DNS name to dotted string.

methods.name: UrlCanonicalizeNameIfAble
methods.description: Canonicalizes a DNS name if possible.
